headline: What the water data really looks like, country by country.
name: Water

rows.fact: The benchmark itself — live-verified keyless; legacy decommission Feb 22, 2027
Strong keyless England APIs; single miss is NRFA licensing — no redistribution
Dense real-time network (~1,600 stations); the gap is policy, not tech
~8,000 stations via keyless API; hours-scale latency — legislated, not accidental
Keyless real-time level + discharge (~2,100 stations) — but level/discharge only
World-class federal-waterway real-time; no national harmonisation — constitutional
Dense 10-minute river network — but portal-only; terms ban automated harvest
~22,000-station network behind a manual registration gate (3–7 days)
~250+ gauges exist but publish as PDFs and app advisories — no machine API
Monthly FTP, not an API; 2,100+ stations stream real-time internally only
Keyless 5-min hydrometry API over 4,200+ stations, discharge history to 1900
Keyless CC0 real-time water API — but only the national main-water system
Dense real-time + 8,000 CCTV + AI flood platform; machine API behind an approval gate
Densest networks on Earth — public machine access closed by 2007 regulation
Century-deep archive; no machine API — station-by-station web CSV with query caps
Canal levels still largely reported by telephone; the ministry publishes news, not data
Keyless GraphQL, 253 stations, 10-min — "the live feed is uncorrected, always 0"
USGS-class real-time + validated archive to 1911 — from nine separate basin websites
40+ years of 15-min discharge, keyless CC-BY — chemistry behind a token gate
Keyless 5-min real-time feeds — on 16 independent council servers, no front door
15-min national meteo-hydro database exists — behind operator login
458-station daily discharge + 70 years of lab quality on keyless CKAN — telemetry walled

headline: What the climate data really looks like, country by country.
name: Climate

rows.fact: The first AT BENCHMARK of the whole country-models program — continental CC0 hourly sensor-measured atmospheric estate plus a keyless per-table CSV inventory
Keyless OGC-API climate estate back to 1840 — but the full inventory's machine path runs through a JS viewer, and only Alert ran continuously 2020–2022
The only country with an operational national top-down verification programme (DECC towers + InTEM) — yet the Met Office's own API sits behind OAuth2 login
Strongest keyless estate in the program — DWD same-day files, no key, no rate limits, CC BY 4.0 — one unlocatable inventory licence line is all that blocks AT
The open data moved house — legacy SYNOP URLs dead, the real estate keyless on object storage — but no homogenized century series, and the API needs a key
Full pipeline, keyless — CRT zips, homogenized 1898–2025 CSV fetched live, live XML feeds — but Japanese-only under the hood, and GOSAT needs registration

World's fastest inventory cadence (quarterly, ~2-month preliminary — REPORTED, unverified this session) and Cape Grim's 1976→ record — but no BoM primary surface could be verified this session (bot-blocked)
2021: 14.314 billion tonnes CO₂e excl. LULUCF (~3-year lag) — while CMA's 256-station GHG monitoring network releases no open data
Official weather data is a paid product with mandatory API keys — an independent civil-society inventory is more openly accessible than the government's machine data
Only one of its trio to file BTR-1 on time and in machine-readable CRT form — but SIRENE's standalone system is retired: the data exists, the API doesn't

headline: What the food data really looks like, country by country.
name: Food

rows.fact: The hypothesized benchmark — blocked by dimension 7: the NASS (National Agricultural Statistics Service) QuickStats REST API returns 401 without a key (OBSERVED)
12th levantamento XLSX from CONAB (Companhia Nacional de Abastecimento), downloadable the same month the season closed; price-collection methods resolved for both series
Eurostat Comext works keyless (monthly wheat exports pulled live); FranceAgriMer's own PDF admits French export data incomplete since Jan 2024
Compact, open estate — quarterly XLSX, CC BY 4.0, zero login barriers — but the ABS (Australian Bureau of Statistics) grain-stocks survey was discontinued ~2012

A stranger fetched a full StatCan table as CSV (132.5 KB zip, no login, OBSERVED); weekly satellite NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) crop-condition maps for 1,607 census subdivisions since 1987
The "closed stocks" hypothesis is REFUTED — FCI (Food Corporation of India) publishes monthly central-pool levels (wheat 48.0 MMT, rice 39.1 MMT — million metric tons, 1 Sept 2026)
Zero published grain-reserve levels in physical units — the world's largest stockpile is modeled by foreigners because the owner won't say the number
The daily prices the country trades on are set by two private exchanges — while the ministry's own production CSV endpoint 404s (OBSERVED ×2)
The war is in the data as documentation, not silence — monthly grain stocks (24.6 Mt at 2026-09-01), occupied oblasts marked к/с, martial-law revision footnotes

The THIN-anchor hypothesis is REJECTED — Nigeria's NBS (National Bureau of Statistics) independently enumerates retail food prices monthly across all 774 local government areas (LGAs) with 700+ of its own staff

scope: food production, stocks, trade, price, nutrition and verification data

headline: What the pandemic data really looks like, country by country.
name: Pandemic

rows.fact: The measurement leg survives — NWSS (National Wastewater Surveillance System) wastewater, 1,234 sites, ~144M people, anonymous machine-readable, public domain — while national case counting was structurally deleted

Killed its entire MEASURED layer (ONS (Office for National Statistics) infection survey final release 24 March 2023; COG-UK (COVID-19 Genomics UK Consortium) "final flight" March 2023) — yet the REPORTED machinery survives: open-licence dashboard API, mandatory weekly SARI (severe acute respiratory infection) Watch from all acute NHS (National Health Service) trusts

The most machine-readable estate of the slate, still alive in 2026: RKI open-data estate on GitHub/Zenodo/OpenCoDE under CC-BY-4.0, AMELAG (wastewater monitoring for epidemiological situation assessment) wastewater pushed 2026-09-23, the weekly ARE (acute respiratory illness) report still publishing

On 1 July 2023 the legal basis for SI-DEP (Système d'Information de Dépistage Populationnel) personal test data expired, and France froze — rather than deleted — its entire emergency machine-readable estate, all still downloadable on data.gouv.fr with the freeze dated and explained

The federation resolves cleanly (states feed NNDSS (National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System); Commonwealth publishes via NINDSS (National Notifiable Disease Surveillance System) and the still-running Australian Respiratory Surveillance Report) — but the national case series is PDFs, not files

Live right now: weekly SRAG (Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave — severe acute respiratory syndrome) banks updated September 2026, SI-PNI (National Immunization Program information system)/RNDS (National Health Data Network) vaccination microdata in 135 CSV parts (~272 GB); one structural sub-miss inside dim 3

CRS (Civil Registration System) 2021 shows 10.2 million registered deaths — a 26% jump over 2020, ~6.3× India's officially reported 335,004 COVID deaths that year; INSACOG (Indian SARS-CoV-2 Genomics Consortium) bulletins stopped 27 March 2023 and the hospital series never opened

The "reported end of zero-COVID reporting" was a thinning, not a blackout: a live weekly sentinel positivity series runs through September 2026 plus monthly national case/death tables (May 2026: 21,861 cases, 1 death); the vaccination ledger never opened

Sequencing depth matched the reputation — NGS-SA (Network for Genomic Surveillance in South Africa) tracked 54,450 genomes, catching BA.2.87.1 — but the estate was wound down: daily case reporting ended 1 Aug 2022, DATCOV (the COVID-19 hospital surveillance system of the NICD — National Institute for Communicable Diseases) closed 31 Dec 2022

Mortality accounting in one pair of numbers: 3,155 registered COVID deaths vs WHO's external MODELED estimate of ~186,000 excess deaths for 2020–2021 (~59×; windows differ — illustrative, not like-for-like); the single structural miss is the hospital series, never opened

scope: case, genomic, hospital, mortality, vaccination and verification data
